cards.answer: The ability to see objects or movement outside your direct line of sight, at the corner of the eyes without moving your head.

cards.prompt: Paracentral vision is narrow, extending about 10 to 20 degrees from the ____ of gaze.
Which is the vision type that focuses on only a small part of the area in front of you?
cards.answer: Paracentral vision, narrow around the center of gaze.

cards.prompt: Which is NOT a benefit of peripheral vision?
cards.answer: Sharp reading is a central-focus task; peripheral vision is for awareness.

cards.prompt: You are driving and a cyclist appears at the edge of your view while you look ahead. Which ability notices it?
cards.answer: Peripheral vision, which detects movement outside your direct line of sight without turning your head.
